headline: the constructive family exists (197 members) and refutes C-A on all 788 of its violations; it also REFUTES C-B and the strong 'frozen above' form. Surviving law is the containment sandwich C-C.

parametrization.constraints: row sums all equal T; every coordinate zero in some row, so v is exact and singleton-normalized for free by paper4's lower-envelope lemma

family.note: the live region is short in each axis, so the family is a region not a ray; closed forms for phi/slacks/window were NOT obtained - the one piece of item 1 not delivered

C_B_counterexample.mechanism: the TIGHT top stratum {2,5} keeps its total exactly (Prop D respected) but redistributes internally: 2 pays 3/8, 5 gains 3/8. Prop D shields a tight suffix as a SET, not its members - that is the loophole.
verified_three_ways: independent Sigma_m ladder + z3 UNSAT uniqueness
full exact-rational exactness certification of all 62 proper coalitions of both games

strong_form_tabulation_and_reversal.after_the_family: false - in the C-B counterexample the stratum above the paying one is not frozen (player 5 gains)

surviving_conjecture.name: C-C (containment sandwich)
surviving_conjecture.statement: W is inside H* is inside S, where H* is the innermost slack richer suffix
surviving_conjecture.evidence: 1041/1041, and confirmed on BOTH sampling regions (random harvest and constructive family) - the first law in this task for which that is true
auxiliary_remarks_also_1041: every strict loser outside S is strictly poorer than every strict loser inside S
every player strictly richer than the richest loser is frozen

SC2.restated: S contains H* - the right half of C-C
SC2.protector_identification: on the 5 BT violations with anything above the paying stratum, the Lemma-C protector is exactly the tight shield H_{j*+1}: phi'-tight 5/5, omits every loser 5/5, minimal such 5/5
SC2.caveat: the family invalidates the per-member reading: in the C-B counterexample the shield {2,5} is phi'-tight and omits the loser, yet its own member 2 loses. Any proof must work with tight SETS, not individual rich players.
SC2.localization_still_dead: exactness of v' at S-completions and at all supersets of S both show zero correlation (34.3% vs 34.7%); a proof must use exactness at coalitions NOT containing S, and the Lemma-C protectors are exactly those phi'-tight sets omitting a member of S

proved: Prop 2 Delta in tangent cone, Delta(S)>0, outside-S loser exists
Prop 3 W proper subset of S
Prop D tight suffixes are shields

paper4_recommendation: claim only what is proved; state C-C as the single conjecture. Theorem A + Theorem B as the theorem, Prop D as the structural proposition, the round-2 and round-3 n=6 games as the two counterexamples retiring 'losers = suffix' and 'losers = one stratum', C-C with 1041/1041 across two sampling regions, and the exactness remark. Section thesis: 'a monotonicity failure is confined to the innermost slack suffix, which the bumped coalition must contain' - a containment statement, not an identification. After two identification conjectures died in two rounds I would not print a fourth.
